{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABXCurSw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhAmPHE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 101, "title": "Simplify default extension graph and stabilize LiveTextDisplay append rendering", "body": "## Problem

The extension's default graph still enables translation and creates two LiveTextDisplay regions (Original and Translation) by default, despite the desired simple starting workflow being **Chrome tab audio → speech recognition → one generic Live text display**. `extension/graph.js` currently defaults `defaultGraph({ enabled = true })` and adds OPUS-MT, PairedTextFormatter and a second display.

Users also report that `LiveTextDisplay.append` appears to replace previous committed text rather than adding new items. The underlying `web/text-nodes.js` state appends to `items`, but `extension/live-text-regions.js` rebuilds every committed `<li>` on each state update with `replaceChildren()`. This can visually resemble replacement and may disrupt selection/scroll; **actual loss of committed items has not been established**. Diagnose rather than assume a data-loss bug.

## Expected outcome

### Minimal default graph

- The default for fresh installations and explicit **Reset draft to default** contains exactly three Nodes: `ChromeTabAudio`, `SpeechToText`, and one `LiveTextDisplay`. No translation, PairedTextFormatter, second Live display, or other optional processing branch.
- Connect `ChromeTabAudio.audio → SpeechToText.audio`, `SpeechToText.provisional → LiveTextDisplay.replace`, and `SpeechToText.final → LiveTextDisplay.append`.
- Keep translation Nodes available in the palette for users to add manually; do not remove translation capability or existing custom graphs. Clearly separate the new default from explicit user-chosen translation configuration.
- Preserve existing saved graphs and their user-defined edges/settings, including translation-enabled graphs. Do not overwrite stored graphs on upgrade; only new default creation or explicit reset uses the simplified graph. Review default construction call sites and any legacy preference migration to avoid silently re-enabling translation or overwriting an intentional saved graph.

### Stable append display and investigation

- Confirm with deterministic state and packaged MV3 UI tests whether committed `append` items are ever lost/replaced, distinguishing actual state mutation from DOM rerendering, source-emitted replacement, and session resets.
- Make rendering incremental where possible: preserve existing committed DOM items when the state has an unchanged prefix, append only newly committed items, and update the preview separately. Correctly handle resets, changes in the saved/active graph, and any legitimate replacement of committed history without stale entries.
- Preserve text content verbatim, including identical repeated finals and empty strings, and prevent HTML interpretation. Avoid losing text selection or unexpectedly jumping scroll position on ordinary preview updates or new appended items.
- Semantics: `replace` updates only the current preview; `append` adds one committed item per emission and clears the preview. Existing committed items must remain visible throughout the same session. New sessions intentionally start with empty display state. Stop/Cancel must not turn preview into a duplicate committed item.
- Keep the rendering improvement narrow: no new graph UI framework, generalized virtual list, or unrelated Live redesign.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests assert the default graph has exactly 3 Nodes and 3 named-port edges, with no translation branch, for fresh setup and explicit Reset.
- [ ] Tests verify persisted custom/translation graphs survive reload/migration unchanged, and translation can still be manually added and run.
- [ ] Unit and packaged MV3 tests show `provisional → replace` changes only preview, `final → append` grows the committed list, and consecutive/repeated/empty final values remain distinct and ordered.
- [ ] Tests reproduce or rule out actual append state loss; verify that repeated preview updates and appends do not needlessly replace existing committed DOM nodes, preserving selection and stable scroll behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Tests cover Stop/Cancel, a new session reset, active vs saved graph changes, and safe rendering of arbitrary text.
- [ ] Update Graph Editor/Live help and `docs/extension-graph.md` to describe the minimal default and replace/append behavior; run applicable unit, browser and packaged MV3 tests plus extension build, reporting skipped or unrun optional real-model checks accurately.

All mandatory checks must be achievable and verifiable **before merge**.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Context

- `extension/graph.js` defaultGraph currently adds translation by default.
- `web/text-nodes.js` `LiveTextDisplayNode.receiveInputs()` pushes every `append` into `items` and clears `preview`.
- `extension/live-text-regions.js` currently calls `items.replaceChildren(...state.items.map(...))` on every display-state update.
- #99 introduced graph-driven Live display sinks. This Issue refines its default graph and display stability, without claiming a proven data-loss defect.
